_about: Integumentary cross-package seam manifest (HANDOFF 5.3): labelled IN / INTERNAL-LIVE / OUT seams for the 'one body' runner. No new mechanism, no new constant; the internal coupling is re-exported from the verified pathology layer, the rest are declarations.

_classes.inherited_in: read-only inputs vendored from a sibling (never re-derived here)
_classes.internal_live: cross-target couplings computed live in this package, exposed as labelled outputs
_classes.declared_out: contracts to sibling packages -- DECLARED, not yet live wiring

internal_live.mechanism: a melanocyte-target lesion removes the melanin screen, so the UV reaching DNA stays full, and the shared multistage hazard rises (RR>1); restoring an (exogenous) screen lowers it again -- the screen is the causal lever
internal_live.grade_shape: [V] cross-target coupling: a T3 screen-loss lesion raises the oncology hazard (sign + direction verified)
internal_live.grade_anchor: [L] albinism markedly elevates cSCC/melanoma; vitiligo patches are photoprotection-deficient; Gandini 2005 intermittent SRR 1.61
internal_live.grade_absolute: [O] absolute RR magnitude: inherits the oncology obstacle (population baseline rate + absolute dose calibration)

inherited_in.note: the vasomotor layer adds only the reactivity dynamics and leaves the perfusion magnitude an inherited citation -- the SSOT seam it was careful not to cross

inherited_in.imported: organ IDENTITY + emergence ORDER + measured master-gene gamma (TP63/KRT14/MITF/EDAR/PRDM1)
inherited_in.consumed_by: every target (each organ rides its measured gamma)
inherited_in.note: identity + order live in DNA; gamma is measured, read-only, never fitted; vendored in inherited/organ_gamma.json + organ_identity.md and re-vendored on change

inherited_in.imported: the FHN / R19 bistable switch ds/dt = g*s - s^3 + h (+ spinodal/barrier/dwell)
inherited_in.note: the one shared primitive; vendored in inherited/vp_substrate.py
